brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a raid on the town of Idna west of Hebron on Thursday, detaining approximately 30 residents after searching multiple homes, Shehab Wire reported. The operation included physical beatings of detainees, field interrogations conducted at the scene, and damage inflicted on civilian residences throughout the town.

The raid specifically targeted the home of a martyr's family alongside other dwellings in Idna. Soldiers systematically searched properties and questioned residents as part of the operation, which residents described as involving aggressive tactics and property destruction.
